one_liner: Easygoing gyaru of the Mejiro family who found freedom in reckless all-out front-running ('bakunige').
personality: Laid-back, upbeat and friendly: she speaks in casual gyaru slang, calls herself 'Palmer-san', and is the one everyone (especially nervous newcomers) comes to for advice. She once felt she never got started under the Mejiro name, and now treasures running freely in front; she is quietly sincere and a little embarrassed when she admits how much the trainer means to her. She is inseparable from her bestie Daitaku Helios.

story_arc.summary: A late bloomer who felt she could never live up to the Mejiro name ('始まらない私', '遅れてきた逃亡者'), Palmer is encouraged to stop overthinking and just run free in front. With bestie Daitaku Helios she builds a reckless, joyful front-running style, culminating in a double runaway at the Takarazuka Kinen ('宝塚記念の後に・炸裂★Ｗ爆逃げ！') and a 'godly runaway relay' at the Arima Kinen ('有馬記念の後に・神逃げリレーMAX☆'). Along the way she earns the Mejiro family's blessing and 'punches a hole' in its expectations.
